known_limitations.detail: Inherited Batch07 sandbox Chromium administrator policy blocks native http/https/file origin navigation; self-contained real Chromium runtime is verified, deployment/native-origin loader remains canonical/deployment follow-up.
QA-009 uses structured synthetic multi-domain/multi-strategy contract fixtures. It does not establish real textbook/domain-fidelity acceptance.
QA-007 verifies accessibility contracts, keyboard parity, compiled interaction policy and browser semantic runtime, but not a real screen-reader/device matrix.
QA-010 observed an inherited __import__(json) use in Batch07 browser_runtime.py. It is not user-controlled keyword routing and did not block GAME-QA, but should be reviewed in Step 2 full audit.
No real-book end-to-end GAME acceptance is claimed in Step 1.
